Seefeld in Tirol

A sunny high plateau above Innsbruck, made for cross-country skiing.

Plan a trip to Seefeld in Tirol

In short

Seefeld in Tirol at a glance.

Seefeld sits on a plateau at about 1,200 m, half an hour above Innsbruck. It hosted the Nordic events of the 1964 and 1976 Winter Olympics and the 2019 Nordic World Ski Championships.

Region
Tyrol, Austria
Skiing
Rosshütte and Gschwandtkopf, and long cross-country trails
Nearest airports
Innsbruck (about 30 minutes), Munich (about 2 hours)
Best for
Cross-country skiing, families, wellness, gentle skiing

Who is it for?

Families, cross-country skiers and anyone who wants a quieter week with spa days, winter walks and easy skiing.

When to go?

Winter for cross-country and downhill skiing; summer for hiking, biking and golf on the plateau.

How do you get there?

Innsbruck Airport is about 30 minutes away by car. Seefeld also has its own station on the railway from Innsbruck to Garmisch-Partenkirchen.
